about: Where each proof step of the paper's statement map (proof_steps) is printed. The paper gives steps neutral labels but no LaTeX anchors, so each is located by the environment whose statement or proof contains it and, for part of a proof, by the LaTeX source text that opens and closes the passage. scripts/paper.py fails when a step of the map has no entry or an entry no longer matches the source. `split` cuts the passage into numbered sub-steps that build-site.py pairs with the `-- Step N` comments of the Lean proof.
